notes: Ten images across seven screens: base and dark states are strong and consistent. Both 1920 wide captures are severely clipped and incomplete.

screens.summary: Sign-in base is clean and complete, but the 1920 wide variant is broken: the form is clipped at 1366px, the panel stops at 768px high and most of the canvas is blank.

issues.observation: Wide capture is severely clipped: heading, supporting copy, fields and button are cut off at 1366px, the dark panel ends at 768px height, and the lower and right areas of the 1920x1080 canvas are empty.

screens.summary: Session-restore screen is complete and legible, with clear progress, step states and balanced centring.
Session-expired dialog is complete and readable; background dimming, fields and both actions fit cleanly.
Access-denied state is complete and consistent, with clear guidance, visible actions and no broken data.
Pending-writes sign-out dialog fits cleanly; grouped changes, conflict warning and all three actions are legible.
Search overlay is complete and legible; only the wrapped footer key hint is a minor cosmetic flaw.

issues.observation: Footer hint "Up/Down to move - Enter to open" wraps "open" onto a second line, so the left hint is two lines while the right note remains one.

screens.summary: Base and dark dashboards look polished, but the wide variant loses the right column, fourth KPI, actions and status pills, leaving most of the canvas empty.

issues.observation: Wide dashboard is confined to the top-left area: today's collections KPI, Needs attention and Due today cards, header actions and row status badges are missing, with large empty areas right and below.
Today's clinic header says "6 of 18 visits shown" but only five visit rows are visible and there is no scroll affordance.
Patient avatar initials are very low contrast against the teal circles in dark mode.
